;Armed conflicts and attacks
*18 people were killed and 23 others were injured when gunmen belonging to the "Union for Peace" group, attacked a funeral ceremony in the town of [[Ippy]], [[Central African Republic]]. [http://www.tribtown.com/2019/01/29/af-central-african-republic-attack/ (''The Tribune'')]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[Brumadinho dam disaster]]
**A mining dam owned by the [[Brazil|Brazilian]] company [[Vale (mining company)|Vale]] collapses in [[Minas Gerais]], leaving 248 dead and 22 people missing. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-48935651 (BBC News)]
*[[2019 South Sulawesi floods]]
**At least 59 people are killed when flooding and landslides hit [[South Sulawesi]], [[Indonesia]]. Twenty-five others are missing and thousands have been displaced. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/01/rescuers-hunt-survivors-indonesia-floods-death-toll-rises-190125004129097.html (Al Jazeera)] [https://sg.news.yahoo.com/dozens-dead-thousands-displaced-flood-223924588.html?fbclid=IwAR1DduP4lWReGr1a9Cmq3IT3T40B2yBijvs7Dklp2wOAP-Ysruc1x8IBtXo (Yahoo! News)]
*A [[airplane|plane]] and a [[helicopter]] collide over [[Testa del Rutor]] near the border of [[France]] and [[Italy]], leaving seven dead. [https://torino.corriere.it/cronaca/19_gennaio_25/aosta-elicottero-contro-aereo-turismo-ghiacciaio-rutor-9c64adaa-20b9-11e9-926b-daa18cae285e.shtml (''Corriere della Sera'')]

;Law and crime
*[[Mueller special counsel investigation]]
**[[Roger Stone]], a former adviser to [[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]], is indicted by a federal grand jury and arrested on charges of [[Obstruction of justice|obstruction]], giving false statements, and witness tampering as part of special counsel [[Robert Mueller]]'s probe into [[Russian interference in the 2016 United States elections]]. [https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/donald-trump/ex-trump-adviser-roger-stone-arrested-part-mueller-probe-n962601 (NBC News)]

;Politics and elections
*[[Macedonia naming dispute]]
** The [[parliament of Greece]] votes 153–146 in approval of changing the name of the [[Republic of Macedonia]] to the Republic of North Macedonia, ending a 27-year [[Macedonia naming dispute|naming dispute]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-47002865 (BBC News)]
*[[2018–19 United States federal government shutdown]]
**[[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]] announces a short-term deal has been reached with congressional leaders to temporarily reopen the federal government after a [[2018-19 United States federal government shutdown |partial shutdown]] that has lasted for 35 days. The stop-gap agreement will last three weeks, until February 15, and will allow for talks to continue over security on the [[Mexico-United States border]]. The temporary deal includes no money for President Trump's [[Mexico–United States barrier#Trump administration|planned additional border barrier with Mexico]]. [https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/donald-trump/trump-shutdown-announcement-n962836?fbclid=IwAR1Rk9IGd8iTTzf-Pa29x0qRLf5ONIJlUEdCEZEKDAl3zp9qWseeXkxGjgc (NBC News)]
*[[2020 United States presidential election]], [[2020 Democratic Party presidential primaries]]
**Two sources with direct knowledge tell Yahoo! News that Senator [[Bernie Sanders]] plans to announce his intention to run for the presidency in the 2020 presidential election. [https://news.yahoo.com/bernie-sanders-set-announce-2020-presidential-run-234647684.html (Yahoo! News)]
**Retired U.S. Army major and former West Virginia State Senator [[Richard Ojeda]] suspends [[Richard Ojeda 2020 presidential campaign|his campaign]] for presidency in the 2020 presidential election. [https://theintercept.com/2019/01/25/richard-ojeda-president-drops-out/ (''The Intercept'')]

*[[2019 Bangsamoro Autonomous Region creation plebiscite]]
**The ratification of the [[Bangsamoro Organic Law]] is proclaimed paving the way for the creation of the [[Bangsamoro Autonomous Region]] in the [[Philippines]]. [https://www.rappler.com/nation/221899-plebiscite-results-armm-votes-ratify-bangsamoro-organic-law (Rappler)]
